hypothesis: H-T9 (new): the compaction cannot corrupt KV for any well-formed NGRAM tree because retrieve links only ever point to larger tree indices, so the accepted path s_0<s_1<... is strictly increasing; a read at packed index i of source slot s_i and a write at packed index j of slot s_i=j therefore always satisfy i<j, and the tiled copy (load all chunk sources, then store) with increasing chunks performs every read before the write that could clobber it. EXECUTED: for all 120 BFS parent trees at n=6 and all 720 root-to-node accepted paths, dense-packed in-place compaction reproduces the independent golden (committed slot j holds KV of node s_j, root slot keeps its own KV) exactly, 0 corruptions, under both tiled and immediate read-after-write orders. Conditional hazard found and quantified: IF the fill helpers do not densely pack but emit positional rows with a zero tail (accept_index=-1 sentinel reads out_cache_loc[-1], tgt_cache_loc stays 0), then destination slot 0 is written from two different sources on every partial accept, corrupting the root KV on 719/720 paths and making the tiled kernel's duplicate-address stores order-dependent.
